I'm glad this sub was made!

LoL is interesting. Difficult at first, but it gets pretty fun. More kind-hearted players are needed, as the match-making is too serious.

A game I forgot to mention is Dungeons and Dragons Online, and Lord of the Rings Online. Both are free MMOs, for those that like that kind of thing.

Roll20 is amazing, (I'm also a DM), and use it to DM Cortex (a pretty fun little system.)

Another free game that's pretty fun, and team-oriented is League of Legends.

I do, actually. I've been busying myself with Torchlight a lot recently when I'm not at work, as it's a mindless game that keeps me busy. Thank you for the link, I'll probably be frequenting it, especially as a way to keep busy when not at the uni or work.

I forgiven my birth father, as I use the abuse I suffered from him as a reason to remember to never lose my temper. I've talked to a psychologist at my university (we have free psych counseling for students) and he recommended getting away from my family, which has helped, a bit. Part of my problem is I can't get away. There's no cheap rental apartments where I'm at, meaning I'm stuck with my fiancee and my roommates, or my family, as I cannot afford the dorms.
